values.note: City of Gladwin 2026-2027 fee schedule: water & electric site $38 a night, water/electric/sewer ('sanitary') site $42; rustic (tent) site $25; weekly $228 / $252 and monthly $912 / $1,008 (50% due at booking). One rate for everyone (no resident/non-resident split posted). Registered campers get the park's vehicle entry permit (otherwise $5 a day) free. Pets $5 a stay. On Campspot (read 2026-10-13) the same $38-42 for October 2026 and June 2027, plus the park's $2 'Campspot Fee' and $5 'Credit Card Fee' once per stay, and Campspot's own booking fee at checkout (3%, at least $3). Late check-out $20.

fees.source: https://www.gladwin.org/Documents%20Center/How%20Do%20I/Fee%20Schedule/2026-2027%20Schedule%20of%20Fees%20.pdf ('Water & Electric Site Nightly 38.00'; 'Sanitary Site Nightly 42.00'; 'Rustic Site Nightly 25.00') + https://www.gladwin.org/visitors/camping___lodging/city_park___campground/index.php (nightly, weekly, monthly rates; 'Registered campers will be provided with entry permits without charge'), read 2026-10-22; Campspot fees read 2026-10-13

season.source: https://www.gladwin.org/visitors/camping___lodging/city_park___campground/index.php ('City Park & Campground Operating Season May 1st - October 31st'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: On Campspot: 49 water/electric back-ins, 6 water/electric pull-throughs and 2 water/electric/sewer sites (all offered to motorhomes; listed lengths to 54-57 ft), 2 rustic tent sites, plus 2 rental cabins.

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/gladwincitypark (park record site types: 'W/E Tent/RV Site Back-In' 49 sites max 57 ft, 'W/E Tent/RV Site Pull Through' 6 sites max 56 ft, 'W/E/S Tent/RV Site' 2 sites max 54 ft, 'Rustic Site' 2 tent sites; audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl), read 2026-10-13

booking.source: https://www.gladwin.org/visitors/camping___lodging/city_park___campground/index.php ('Make a Reservation Online' / 'Reserve a Campsite or Pavilion Here', linking https://www.campspot.com/book/gladwincitypark), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Gladwin campground on the Cedar River, with a sandy swimming beach, a boat launch, canoe, kayak and tube rentals, and 2 rental cabins. --Claude
